explanation: For each node, collect colors already used by its neighbors and choose a palette color outside that set.
correctness: At most degree(node) colors are forbidden by its neighbors. A prefix of degree(node)+1 distinct colors therefore contains an available color. A later neighbor avoids this assigned color, so every edge remains valid.
walkthrough: For the triangle with adjacency [[1,2],[0,2],[0,1]] and palette [red,blue,green], assign red to v0, blue to v1 because v0 is red, and green to v2 because its neighbors use both red and blue. Every edge has different endpoint colors. Any other valid assignment also passes; the displayed true reports successful properties.
timeComplexity: O(V + E) time; each palette scan stops within degree(node)+1 choices.
